notes:
Your local database stays leaner and your desktop edits reach your other devices sooner, alongside a faster startup and a few editor fixes.

**New**

- **Leaner local database (dev).** The app now keeps its edit history tidy on its own — a background **compaction** collapses redundant history behind a 90-day version horizon and reclaims the freed-up space, so the database stops growing without bound. There's also a **"Compact database"** action in **Settings → Storage** if you want to run it yourself. It's safe by design: it checks its work before and after and takes a backup first. (PRD Addendum 26 Part 2.)
- **Your desktop edits reach other devices sooner.** The app now syncs when you switch away from its window, and it picks up the pace while you still have unsynced changes — so what you just wrote shows up on your phone and other devices faster. (PRD Addendum 25 §W5; #596.)

**Fixes & polish**

- **Faster startup.** The database backup taken at launch no longer holds up the app from opening — it runs in the background, and is skipped entirely when a recent backup already exists. (#597.)
- **Enter behaves at the parent level.** Pressing Enter after a line that has no real children now starts a fresh line at the same level, instead of dropping you into an indented sub-level. Stray empty blocks left behind by the earlier behavior are cleaned up too. (#602.)
- **Strikethrough over a link.** Toggling strikethrough across a selection that starts with a `[[link]]` no longer inserts a stray `~` or drops part of your text. (#598.)

**Under the hood**

- **Block ordering now uses fractional ranks.** Reordering a block writes a *single* change instead of renumbering every block after it — dramatically slowing the database's growth going forward. (PRD Addendum 26 Part 1.)
- Added the op-log **compaction engine** with an exhaustive never-prune safety proof plus convergence tests, and telemetry (`compaction_ran`, `phantom_children_repaired`) to track its impact. (PRD Addendum 26 Part 2a; #602.)
